Package game.positions

Interface Waterable

All Known Implementing Classes:
Cauliflower, Dirt, Melon, Parsnip, Strawberry
public interface Waterable
Capability interface for Ground that can be watered by an Actor carrying a watering tool. Implementing classes define what happens when they are watered: a Dirt tile turns into a Puddle, and a crop records the watering and applies its own effect.

  • Method Details

    • water

      String water(Actor actor, Location location)
      Applies the effect of watering this Ground. Assumes the caller has already checked that the Actor has a watering tool and enough stamina. A crop must record the watering before it applies its effect, because several crop rules depend on the watering count.
      Parameters:
      actor - the Actor watering this Ground
      location - the Location of the Ground being watered
      Returns:
      a description of the outcome, to be displayed to the player

    • getWateringStaminaCost

      default int getWateringStaminaCost(int toolCost)
      Returns the stamina cost of watering this Ground. The default is the cost of the tool itself; a Ground that has its own cost overrides it and ignores the tool's cost.
      Parameters:
      toolCost - the stamina cost of the watering tool
      Returns:
      the stamina cost of watering this Ground
